description: We are Team four_phantoms, a passionate team of technology and space enthusiasts participating in the NASA Hackathon. We are interested in space exploration, innovation, web development, and solving real-world challenges using technology and NASA data. We believe in teamwork, creativity, and building impactful solutions. We are looking for enthusiastic members skilled in coding, AI/ML, UI/UX design, research, and problem-solving who want to create something amazing together!
summary:
Antariksh View is an interactive and engaging space-learning platform designed especially for children and young learners. Our goal is to make learning about space, planets, and the universe simple, enjoyable, and accessible.

Traditional learning methods can sometimes make space science difficult and less engaging for young students. Antariksh View addresses this challenge through a fun, cartoon-inspired website experience that encourages curiosity and exploration.

The platform provides an engaging environment where children can explore space-related topics, discover fascinating facts, participate in quizzes, and learn through interactive activities.

Our project aims to transform space education into an exciting learning adventure rather than just reading information from textbooks. By combining technology, creativity, and interactive learning, Antariksh View inspires the next generation to explore beyond imagination.
details: Antariksh View is an interactive, cartoon-based space education platform designed to make learning about the universe fun, simple, and engaging for children. Our platform allows young explorers to discover all 8 planets, explore galaxies, learn fascinating space facts, and participate in interactive space quizzes. Key features include: 1. Solar System Explorer – Explore planets and discover their interesting facts. 2. Galaxy Explorer – Discover black holes, stars, nebulas, moons, and galaxies. 3. Space Missions – Five playable missions including Moon Explorer, Mars Survival, Alien Rescue, and Asteroid Dodge. 4. Interactive Space Quiz – Test knowledge through different difficulty levels. 5. Rocket Workshop – Build and customize your own rocket. 6. Extra Fun Zone – Enjoy space puzzles, memory games, and astronaut training activities. The platform combines educational content, interactive games, animations, and gamification to encourage curiosity and make space science accessible to young learners. Our goal is to transform traditional space learning into an exciting digital adventure and inspire children to explore science and the universe.
